input.change_text: We've launched **Claude Platform on AWS**, bringing the Claude API to Anthropic-managed infrastructure accessible through AWS, with AWS billing and IAM authentication. Access the full Messages API, Files API, Message Batches API, Claude Managed Agents, Agent Skills, code execution, and tool use through native AWS endpoints. Learn more in [Claude Platform on AWS](/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws).

output.subject: Claude Platform on AWS launched
output.action_text: Reach the Claude API through `Claude Platform on AWS` if you prefer AWS billing and IAM auth — Messages, Files, Batches, CMA, Skills, code execution, and tool use are all available via native AWS endpoints. Existing direct-API consumers are unaffected.
